data.title: TNS to Tackle Cross-Channel Fraud and Customer Trust in Two Sessions at CFCA Fall Educational 2026
data.description: In Reston, Virginia, a report on communications fraud highlighted the evolving tactics used by bad actors, who target various channels like voice, messaging, email, applications, and social media. They often spoof phone numbers of financial institutions to deceive customers and take advantage of fragmented intelligence systems that make prevention challenging. This has led to a growing trust gap among consumers, with an increasing wariness towards even legitimate communications. The report emphasized the need for unified strategies across industries and countries to combat this issue effectively. #CFCAFall2026.

data.title: Elmhurst 1925 Launches Clean Protein™ in Canada, Redefining Ready-to-Drink Nutrition
data.description: Elmhurst® 1925, a leading producer of plant-based products, has launched Clean Protein™ in Canada. This ready-to-drink plant-based protein beverage contains 27g of complete protein, only 190 calories, and is free from gums, seed oils, and artificial sweeteners. This move showcases Elmhurst's dedication to simple ingredients and top-notch performance, setting a new standard in the RTD protein market.

data.title: The Coca-Cola Company Names Rob Gehring President of North America Operating Unit
data.description: Atlanta-based The Coca-Cola Company revealed that Rob Gehring will take on the role of president for the North America division starting December 1, 2026. This appointment comes after John Murphy had been serving as interim president since August 1, 2026. Murphy will continue in his roles as president and CFO. Gehring, aged 59, will be joining the company following a stint at Monster Energy Company, where he served as CEO for the Americas. Previously, he had worked at Coca-Cola before taking on this new role.

data.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
data.description: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXS), a prominent residential furniture manufacturer in the United States, is set to be part of the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, held online on September 29-30, 2026. The company will engage in a webcast presentation at 1:00 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 20 and conduct individual meetings with investors during the conference. data.title: Edison International, Southern California Edison Declare Dividends
data.description: In Rosemead, California, the board of directors of Edison International (NYSE: EIX) announced a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.8775 per share to be paid on October 31, 2026, for shareholders of record on October 7, 2026. data.title: Crescent Biopharma Announces Grants of Inducement Awards
data.description: On September 25, 2026, Crescent Biopharma, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBIO) in Waltham, Mass., declared that the Compensation Committee of its Board of Directors sanctioned the allocation of options enabling the purchase of a total of 31,200 shares of the Company’s ordinary shares to two non-executive employees. This was done as equity inducement awards under the Crescent Biopharma, Inc. 2025 Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan. These options, approved on September 24, 2026, were significant in securing the employment of each individual with Crescent, as per Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

data.title: Marvell Technology, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend Payment
data.description: A company in Santa Clara, California, Marvell Technology, Inc. Marvell is dedicated to providing data infrastructure technology that interconnects the globe, emphasizing collaborations with customers as the pivotal framework for developing solutions. data.title: Thimble and Bold Penguin Launch AI-Powered Integration to Streamline Insurance Quoting
data.description: In New York, a prominent digital small business Managing General Agent (MGA), Thimble, has revealed a recent collaboration and integration with Bold Penguin, United States' biggest insurance distribution platform. The partnership involves the development of a tool that enables their platforms to independently identify, communicate, and complete small business quoting activities through AI agent-to-agent communication. This integration empowers Bold Penguin users to utilize AI-supported natural language processing to efficiently generate and finalize quotes.

data.title: U.N. reveals list of firms linked to Israeli settlements in West Bank; Israel denounces move as a "smear campaign."
data.description: Israel strongly criticized the compilation of a database containing companies involved in operations in the occupied West Bank, denouncing it as a biased "tool for political purposes" aimed at tarnishing their reputation.
